reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DSH Web 会话界面提供可视化导航：按对话轮次绘制会话小地图条形区，并支持悬停预览与点击跳转。依据仓库 README 与 package 配置，它通过主机会话大纲与快照数据生成导航视图，并在需要时分页加载历史消息后跳转，因此属于界面导航面板类。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 会话界面显示会话小地图，按轮次生成垂直条并支持悬停查看预览和点击跳转到对应消息位置。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a session minimap to DSH Web, showing one bar per turn with hover preview and click-to-jump navigation to the corresponding message.

capabilities: conversation navigation overlay in DSH Web
jumping to turns using host message anchors
fetching session outline from host-provided endpoint
loading older turns through pagination when navigating
rendering plain-text turn previews for hovered bars

reasons.code: README states a vertical rail is rendered for the full conversation with one bar per turn, hover preview, and click-to-jump behavior.
README documents fetching `/dsh-conversation-rail/api/outline?sessionId=` and aligning live snapshot data by `user/message` sequence for navigation.
README notes that clicking an unloaded turn triggers repeated `session.loadOlder()` calls up to a page limit, which can involve network/page-fetch activity.
package.json declares DSH web client injection and exports plugin entrypoints for host/runtime integration.
